# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 84 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 49 | Coptic

---

## Saying 84

Jesus said: "When you see your likeness, you rejoice. But when you see your images which came into being before you — which neither die nor become manifest — how much will you be able to bear?"

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- **ⲉⲓⲛⲉ** / *eine*: "likeness" — the visible image, what you see in a mirror
- **ϩⲓⲕⲱⲛ** / *hikōn*: "images" (plural) — the pre-existent archetypes or heavenly doubles
- The two terms are distinguished: *eine* (likeness = earthly self) vs. *hikōn* (images = pre-existent archetypal self)
- "Which came into being before you" — the images are pre-existent, ontologically prior to the earthly person
- "Neither die nor become manifest" — the archetypes are neither mortal nor visible in ordinary reality
- "How much will you be able to bear?" — the confrontation with the pre-existent self is overwhelming; it tests the capacity of the earthly person
